summary: Internal collection paging captures authoritative metadata and uses a per-store-open epoch, including same-process reopen and restore.

schema.detail: No persisted schema change; existing maintenance generation is retained.

compatibility.detail: Internal collection cursors reset after store reopen. Unrelated host writes do not invalidate them. Same-epoch frontier regression remains inconsistent, not reset. No new HTTP selector, stream, capability or client activation; legacy serialization is unchanged.

recovery.detail: No stored state changes. Reverting restores the previous internal epoch behavior.
